title: MAP LOOT TAGS TAKE A BACK SEAT
why: The critic still found loot labels too loud and contract bars stopped before the common right edge.
now: Loot tags use medium muted type, wider spacing and shorter halos. Nearby tags lose tiny leaders. Contract bars reach the same edge as status and rewards.
